description.text: Half-day 4x4 backcountry adventure into Arches National Park with an experienced guide in Jeep Wranglers. Off-pavement trails access views most visitors miss; guides rotate passengers among seats. Stops include Arches National Park Backcountry, Tower Arch Area. Timed-entry tickets are NOT needed. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Arches National Park experience without coordinating timed entry, trailheads, or backcountry logistics on their own. Routes stay oriented to Arches National Park Backcountry, Tower Arch Area that define this Moab-area park experience.
